The brushes are super soft, and seem very durable. The bigger brushes come with plastic 'brush guards'. My favorite brush is the foundation brush which feels amazing on my skin. Not only are the brushes soft, but they are very full. The only concern with the brushes is the small fan one-it seems a little less full than what

I haven't got any shedding since I bought it so that was a plus. The only downside is the smell but you can air out the makeup case and theres no blending crease brush. But still this is the best purchased and I recommend if your in a budget.
This product is wonderful. The brushes are so soft and the handle is really long and nice. I would really recommend this product!

I really liked the brushes sent. They are perfect for travel and arrived in a beautiful case. I would recommend this product to everyone who needs an inexpensive but good brush set. They were a bargain for the price.

reviews.t: all the brushes are the same
reviews.x: the brushes are decent but i was kind of disapointed in the variety. all the brushes were the same thickness, they are all pretty firm, i was thinking it would have a couple fluffier eyeshadow brushes but they are all the same stiff brush just with different shaped tips which really is kind of pointless. i like the case they came in though lol

I  absolutely love these brushes the met my needs and more they are inexpensive but they apply my makeup so well I would almost think they where high end brushes. If your thinking about getting some quality but low end makeup brushes I would suggest you try these!!!
I really liked these make up brushes, good value for the money.  Brushes came in a nice case and I gave them as gifts.  The people who received the gifts loved them, it looked much more expensive.
Although these were great the first couple of weeks, all the sudden the handless ( the wood part) start to fall off, and now i am just left with the brush part of all of them.

reviews.t: AMAZING QUALITY AND TOUCH TO THE SKIN
reviews.x: I got these brushes a day in advance of the estimated arrival and that by itself is great. I was exicted to get them in the mail today, and must say how chic the case is. The brushes, OMG. Wow they are soooooooooooo soft. It's like a feather soft to the touch, it is just wonder. I found myself just passing the brushes back and forth on the face, because they feel so soft. I am definitely a happy customer and I a very please with my purchase.

I had ordered 4 of these as Christmas presents for others and was so impressed when they arrived that I had to order another set for myself.  Again, I was very impressed by the quality of the brushes and the quantity especially for the price.  They also traveled a very long way (Hawaii to Virginia) and still arrived within a reasonable length of time.  I am very satisified with everything.

The brushes are of good quality.  The larger brushes are perfect.  However, I would've preferred the smaller brushes to be fuller, and less flat.  Overall, still a very good buy.  As far as the smell some of the other reviewers mentioned....that's just the smell of plastic.  It's not a big deal and happens when anything plastic like that is enclosed in a mail shipment.  Good Buy!

I still have these brushes after over two years of usage. have experienced NO SHEDDING. for such a price, it is awesome. i bought these when i started using makeup and did not want anything experience. am surprised at how it has held up. would definitely recommend

reviews.t: You get what you pay for, in a good way
reviews.x: I have never used makeup in my life - except for lip balm, lipstick and occasional concealer, which don't really require brushes for application. That being said, I think this makeup brush kit is a great place to start for a beginner. They do shed a little bit and one of the brushes completely came out of its clasp - but for ~$1/brush + case, I wasn't really expecting all that much. The eye brushes also aren't too big, which are perfect for my small features. The case is also compact and decent

I ordered this kit based on the 4-star rating. When I received it I found that the eyeshadow brushes are way too stuff to really be useful. The powder and foundation brushes are great, the lip and eyeliner brushes are excellent, if a bit long (but bristles are easy to trim). The fan brush is okay, and the case is okay as well.  The case is a bit larger than I expected (I neglected to measure my purse before ordering the brush set) so it barely fits in my purse so I usually bring a smaller brush

If you want a lot of brushes but dont want to pay a lot of money, then this is going to be the kit for you. I wanted some brushes to start doing my eyeshadow blending better and this kit comes with all different kinds of brushes for blending, except for crease blending brush. It came packaged nicely and each and every brush has a plastic cover around it. When I used the brushes they were very soft and they blended very well. claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the brushes as soft and good quality for the price.
Many reviewers highlight the set as excellent value, often noting the low price and included case.
Several reviewers report no shedding and good durability over time.
A few reviewers complain about the smell of the case or brushes.
Some reviewers are disappointed with the brush variety, finding the brushes too similar or stiff, and one reports handles falling off.
